g.text: 0.5 A polyfuse, Schottky reverse-polarity diode, 15 V TVS, 47 uF bulk

g.desc: 0.5 A polyfuse, Schottky reverse-polarity diode, 15 V TVS, 47 uF bulk

g.text: +/-5 V: inverting charge pump with positive and negative LDOs (LTC3260)

g.desc: +/-5 V: inverting charge pump with positive and negative LDOs (LTC3260)

g.text: EN = AVDD x R69/(R68+R69): starts after AVDD; +2.5 V = 0.8 V (1 + R66/R67)

g.desc: EN = AVDD x R69/(R68+R69): starts after AVDD; +2.5 V = 0.8 V (1 + R66/R67)

g.text: Start-up order (the AD3552R wants AVDD first):

g.desc: Start-up order (the AD3552R wants AVDD first):

g.text: +2.5 V: buck converter (AP63201), enabled once AVDD is up

g.desc: +2.5 V: buck converter (AP63201), enabled once AVDD is up

g.text: AVDD = V_FB (1 + R60/R61); C62 feed-forward; C61 soft start / noise filter

g.desc: AVDD = V_FB (1 + R60/R61); C62 feed-forward; C61 soft start / noise filter

g.text: EN+/EN- from +2V5: the pump starts after the buck

g.desc: EN+/EN- from +2V5: the pump starts after the buck

g.text: Separate beads keep the DAC digital current off the logic supply
